name: PageOne
author: tglazier

sections.description:
PageOne 4 brings the full PageOne dashboard into wp-admin. Every tool available at dashboard.unitedsoftwaretech.com is available here, with the same design, and publishes directly to this WordPress site.

Create

  • AI blog posts (one-off or scheduled auto-generation) with optional AI images
  • Meta descriptions & focus keyphrases, written straight onto your posts (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress supported)
  • AI images, added to your Media Library in one click
  • Keyword research with saved keyword lists
  • AI Page Builder that publishes pages to this site
  • Social posts from your content

Optimize

  • Site audit
  • Content score

Grow

  • Schema markup
  • Internal link suggestions
  • Local SEO
  • Competitor tracking
  • SERP rankings (Google Search Console vs live Google)
  • Client reports

WordPress-native

  • One-click site connection — PageOne creates a dedicated Application Password, no copying credentials
  • Save any generated blog as a WordPress draft, with the featured image imported to your Media Library
  • Apply generated meta descriptions / keyphrases to the matching post on this site

Free and paid plans are available; your plan determines monthly quotas and which tools are included.

Privacy

PageOne sends the content you ask it to generate or analyse (keywords, URLs, page text) to the PageOne service at pageone.unitedsoftwaretech.com, operated by United Software Technologies. Publishing uses a WordPress Application Password stored encrypted by the PageOne service. See https://unitedsoftwaretech.com/privacy for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or install from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate, then open PageOne in the admin menu.
  3. Sign in with your PageOne account (or create one). Existing v3 licenses are migrated automatically.
  4. (Recommended) PageOne → Settings → Connect this site so PageOne can publish to this site.
sections.faq:
Do I still need Yoast SEO?

No. PageOne writes meta descriptions and keyphrases through Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress when one is active, and falls back to its own description tag otherwise.

Where did the old menu pages go?

The v3 pages (Generate Blog, Meta & Focus Keyphrase, Rank Tracking, Keyword Research, Generate Image) are now sections of the PageOne dashboard. Old bookmarks redirect automatically.

Why does PageOne open full-screen?

The dashboard takes over the page so it looks and behaves exactly like the web version. Use “Back to WordPress” in the PageOne sidebar to return to wp-admin.

= 4.0.1 8/19/2026=
* Fix: sites upgrading from 3.x could error on first load while migrating the existing license.
* Meta Description: pick a post/page on this site, choose which generated description to apply, and open the post in the editor after applying.
* Settings page cleanup.

= 4.0.0 8/19/2026=
* Complete rewrite: the full PageOne dashboard now runs inside WordPress with design parity to the web app.
* New tools in the plugin: Page Builder, Social Posts, Site Audit, Content Score, Schema Markup, Internal Links, Local SEO, Competitors, SERP Rankings, Client Reports, AI insights, auto blog generation.
* One-click site connection via Application Passwords.
* Save generated blogs as drafts, import AI images to the Media Library, apply meta to posts (Yoast / Rank Math / SEOPress / fallback).
* Features can be enabled per surface (web dashboard vs WordPress plugin) by PageOne.
* Legacy v3 licenses migrate automatically; old admin page URLs redirect.
